etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English dauncer, dawncere, dancere, equivalent to dance +‎ -er.

definitions.definition: (dance) A person who dances, usually as a hobby, an occupation, or a profession.
(obsolete, slang) Synonym of garreter (“a thief who used housetops to enter by garret windows”)

quote.citation: 1889, Charles Tempest Clarkson, J. Hall Richardson, Police!, page 260:
quote.text: [A]bout 40 were burglars, "dancers," "garreters," and other adepts with the skeleton keys.
